scope: Tushare canonical SH/SZ factor quality audit coverage
diagnostic_evidence_definition: Factor appears in at least one diagnostic artifact; this is not equivalent to complete predictive quality or admission.
representative_candidate_quality_definit: A prior representative-candidate screen contains 28 factors with validation metrics; it includes provisional, redundant, annual-fail, and replay-blocked outcomes and is not a replacement for the current 16-factor rematerialized quality set.

targeted_followup.reason: Canonical Tushare rematerialization is predictive, but four-window replay still has localized amount-precision mismatches against historical YesLab values.

adjusted_market_followup.reason: Adjusted Tushare fields are now available to the calculator, but historical CS spread values still disagree at many rows; retain the factors as isolated until source adjustment convention is reconciled.

precision_diagnostic.interpretation: YesLab stores adjusted high/low at a lower effective precision than the Tushare daily*adj_factor product; this precision difference propagates through the Corwin-Schultz rolling calculation.

csad_followup.reason: The CSAD rolling peer selection is sensitive to adjusted-price precision, and 38 historical source codes have no Tushare market coverage in the replay window. Neither discrepancy is repaired by the adjusted-field adapter.

csad_remaining_outputs_followup.reason: All remaining CSAD outputs inherit the same rolling peer-selection sensitivity and historical-code coverage gaps as yeslab_481; no CSAD output is eligible for admission.

financial_alias_followup.reason: The daily values are exactly reproducible from announcement-date financial inputs on the bounded audit, but both factors have near-zero negative 2021 TRAIN RankIC despite strong coverage. They fail annual stability and remain excluded; further validation cannot restore admission without a distinct, pre-specified transformation.

calculator_inventory.matching_policy: Exact FACTOR_CONFIG factor_name match, GP_NNN source name with GP_Factor_NNN_Calculator.py present, explicit CSAD/Corwin-Schultz output adapter, or an explicit catalog alias for ROE/ROIC.
calculator_inventory.interpretation: Most remaining factors are computationally reproducible in principle; seven CSAD/Corwin-Schultz factors still need adjusted-field mapping before Tushare canonical replay. All require PIT checks, predictive quality, similarity, and formula replay evidence.

interpretation.remaining_library: The remaining catalog factors have not been granted admission evidence by this audit and must remain isolated from model inputs.
